executive_summary.overview: This report documents the adversarial robustness evaluation of the SecOpsAI XGBoost detection model. Five attack types were evaluated using IBM Adversarial Robustness Toolbox (ART). The model was then hardened using adversarial training and re-evaluated.
executive_summary.key_finding: The model survived 3 out of 5 adversarial attacks post-hardening, meeting the project requirement.
executive_summary.recommendation: Deploy the hardened model to production. Monitor for model drift and re-evaluate robustness every 30 days.

defense_accuracy_tradeoff.note: A 5% accuracy drop is acceptable given the significant improvement in adversarial robustness. The hardened model is more reliable in real-world attack scenarios.

open_risks.risk: CW attack still breaks the model post-hardening
open_risks.mitigation: Rate limiting on API prevents automated CW attacks in production

open_risks.risk: Model trained on CICIDS 2017 dataset may not generalize to newer attack patterns
